name: Feature Grid Optimization (Explicit vs Implicit Regularization)
definition: Two training strategies for optimizing the shared feature grid: explicit regularization (direct gradient-based optimization of grid values) and implicit regularization (using an MLP auto-encoder to predict features from spatial coordinates).
summary: Feature Grid Optimization trains voxel grids via explicit direct optimization, implicit MLP prediction, or hybrid methods to balance reconstruction quality against computational efficiency and overfitting risks.
